title: Leif Bloomquist - Dungeon of The Rogue Daemon: A multiplayer roguelike for retro + modern platforms
speaker: Leif Bloomquist
talk_title: Dungeon of The Rogue Daemon: A multiplayer roguelike for retro + modern platforms
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Leif is a retro gamer and hacker! His passion is exploring the intersection of old and new technologies, and how to reinvent classic genres into multiplayer experiences. He discusses the continued development of his multiplayer roguelike, now titled Dungeon of The Rogue Daemon, and opens it up to the conference to play live.

Find him on Twitter: https://twitter.com/schemafactor
Play Dungeon of The Rogue Daemon! http://rogue.jammingsignal.com/rogue/
Leif's 2019 Roguelike Celebration update: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ASGn5J9PHbs
Leif's 2018 Roguelike Celebration talk first introducing his game: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y0K-e83wYnQ
